title: Separate pinned evidence reads from exclusive writable regions in scoped admission

ask.request: Inspect scoped_admission.py C1 read-versus-exclusive-write coupling; implement narrowly or file a precise bounded blocking repair without reviving ops-stuck-resource.

bug_shape: Canonical evidence_policy C1 source_paths are imported into protected regions. A required read of the entire board is then treated as an exclusive dependency/write region against every foreign PR; unchanged candidate boards cannot be narrowed to a row delta.
precise_mechanism: verify(): required includes every canonical evidence_policy source_paths entry (lines 436-446 in pinned source), so C1's board read must be a protected region.
Row scoping requires region.path in the candidate delta and exact row_delta (lines 474-478); a candidate that only reads the board cannot narrow it to its row.
Foreign branch/PR changed_paths are compared against every declared region; divergent whole-board results accumulate overlaps (lines 533-552), rejected at line 622.
PR450@17bf88d49d6ed748de163a98c7d42057ae79afec is still open and changes td-248's board row. Preserve that foreign row, ownership and acceptance correction.
Task/evidence-policy source bindings are legitimate read pins; they are not inherently an exclusive write grant. Real source dependencies and owner/queue/stop conflicts must remain protected.

scope.requires: Independently accepted narrow contract and current ownership handoff before implementation; this filing activates no author.
scope.excluded: No mutation of ops-stuck-resource task/board/history; no broad documentation waiver; no removal of source pinning, all-PR inventories, real write overlap, semantic dependencies, ownership, queues, stops or acceptance gates.

completion_criteria.criterion: Introduce an explicit pinned-read role distinct from exclusive write/owner dependencies.
completion_criteria.verification: Authenticate canonical read bytes at the selected base; do not silently recategorize existing regions. Independent reviewer confirms any canonical source classified read-only has no semantic write dependency.

completion_criteria.criterion: Read-only board consumption may coexist with a disjoint foreign row edit, while genuine conflicts still fail.
completion_criteria.verification: Offline real-Git fixture: unchanged candidate board read plus PR450-shaped foreign row passes only with explicit read classification; actual write/write, relevant owner/queue/stop, stale read pin, candidate row narrowing, changed rules and semantic dependency divergence fail.

completion_criteria.criterion: Governance and parked budgets remain unchanged.
completion_criteria.verification: Retain scoped/evidence/coordinator tests and every preexisting assertion; no guard PASS or retry is granted to ops-stuck-resource by this proposal. Independently review exact source before adoption.
